vulnerabilities.title: Express.js Open Redirect via malformed URLs
vulnerabilities.description: Express before 4.19.2 is affected by an open redirect vulnerability when passing untrusted user input directly to res.location().

vulnerabilities.title: Prototype Pollution in lodash
vulnerabilities.description: Prototype pollution in lodash versions prior to 4.17.21 via zipObjectDeep allowing attackers to inject properties into Object.prototype.
